systems.name: 1.1 Vehicle Movement Model
systems.notes: Arcade-style drift handling: acceleration, braking, steering, handbrake turns. Physics using forces with grip curve and drift angle scaling.
tasks: Acceleration and top-speed cap per vehicle

systems.name: 1.2 Collision & Wall Bounce
systems.notes: Soft wall collisions with speed reduction and bounce. Track boundaries defined by spline with width.
tasks: Sticky collisions at high speed (prevent wall riding)

systems.name: 1.3 Ground Detection & Jump Mechanics
systems.notes: Vehicles can jump off ramps and over gaps. Use raycasting to detect ground for landing and jump tokens.

systems.name: 1.4 Camera System
systems.notes: Dynamic third-person chase cam with drift offset. Smooth follow, look-ahead, and collision avoidance.
